ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral, contiguous white geometric regions occupying the core of both lobes. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits a largely continuous linear boundary with low-amplitude serrations; minor pixel-level irregularities are visible on the right lobe's medial trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of dark vertical linear markings consistent with rake marks on the ventral surface of both lobes; slight irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Embedded alphanumeric metadata labels 'NAHWC #1038' and 'YoNAH #0120' positioned at the base of the image frame.
